Name: Blooming Paradise Original Art Colorful Rugs
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]Painted Paradise Rugs by CosmicSweetpea[/b]

I have been using these rugs in my game for a couple of years now and wanted to share them with you guys.

I worked as a texture designer for commercial projects. This collection returns to that part of my creative background by taking my own original paintings and adapting them into functional in game surfaces. Each design began as real painted artwork, then was prepared and scaled for use as Stardew Valley furniture while preserving the layered brushwork, saturated color, organic movement, and tropical botanical detail of the original pieces.

These are not AI generated patterns or stock textures. They are original designs developed from real paintings and translated into a playable rug collection. The designs in this collection come from Blooming Carnaval & Blooming Paradiso, an original surface design series I created under my Wild Rose Flamingo & Belliaroze studio practice.

[heading]What’s Included[/heading]
The collection contains [b]16 unique rugs[/b] in several sizes:
[list]
[*]Two 3×3 tile rugs [/*]
[*]Three 4×4 tile rugs [/*]
[*]Eleven 6×6 tile rugs[/*]
[/list]
[b]👽 About the AI Tag  👽 [/b]
[list]
[*]I am using this tag on all of my mods now, regardless of how the individual assets were made because I have apparently reached the stage of my 20 year career where strangers require a forensic investigation before believing I can draw an alien. The tag is not a confession that every asset was generated by AI. It is a tongue-in-cheek response to every mod page now needing to double as a courtroom exhibit proving that its creator possesses motor skill[/*]
[*]I have decided to save everyone the trouble and tag the entire catalogue. Please consider this my formal confession that I have never created anything in my life and simply wanted attention. Thank you to the concerned citizens who helped me discover this.[/*]
[*][b]Download the mod or do not. You may conduct your own forensic investigation into whether this is satire.[/b][/*]
[/list]
